title: Read Slack channel history with AI, including its limits
h1: read a stretch of slack channel history with ai
description: Ask a bot to retrieve a Slack conversation’s main timeline for a date window. Know when more results or missing thread replies makes the reading incomplete.
keyword: read slack channel history with ai
answer: a bot can retrieve the main timeline of a slack channel or direct conversation you can access, then read a chosen stretch for you. this action does not return threaded replies. if a timeline message points to a discussion, the bot needs a separate thread-reading action to read it. keep the bot read only when the result belongs solely in your dusk chat.
og_line: read the timeline within its limits.
what:
give the bot the conversation and the period you want to inspect. name the channel and the bot finds it. time filters narrow the main timeline to that period.

a parent message can show that replies exist without returning what they say. the bot should either fetch that thread separately with retrieve conversation replies, or label the account as timeline-only.
uses: reconstruct the announcements made in a channel during your holiday
collect the main-channel messages around an outage before choosing which threads to investigate
read the recent timeline of an accessible direct conversation before a handover

routine.message: each saturday at 10:45, read the past week's main timeline in the slack channel harborflint-dispatch. bring the announced collection times and changed pickup locations here, with the time each was posted. flag announcements with thread replies as needing a thread check rather than assuming the first message is final. never post, react or edit anything in slack.
routine.needs: slack connected with read only access to channel identification and conversation history
routine.output:
harborflint dispatch timeline
- beatriz announced a friday pickup at the north gate.
- hugh posted a revised collection window; replies exist and have not been read.
thread confirmation needed before treating that window as final.

steps: connect slack under **Connected apps** and set this reader to **read only**.
identify the channel or conversation and confirm that the connected account can open it.
give the time window, then decide whether the job should also allow the separate thread-reading action.
ask for one dated extract first. once it covers the intended period, schedule it and check the next runs under **Automations**.
watch: history doesn't include replies inside threads; the bot reads those separately.
a busy channel comes back in parts; the bot should keep reading until it has the whole week.
slack may return fewer messages than requested. a short page is not enough evidence that the conversation has ended.

faq.q: why did the summary miss a reply inside a thread?
faq.a: conversation history returns the main timeline only. retrieve conversation replies is the separate action for the parent message’s thread.

faq.q: can it read private channels and direct messages?
faq.a: the action supports those conversation types when the authenticated user or bot can access them. it cannot read conversations the account cannot access.
